questions.question: Describe the mechanisms by which microbes from humans are dispersed into the air.
questions.solution_html:
• Mechanisms of microbial dispersion into air (from humans)
  • • Sneezing and coughing release droplets. Talking and breathing produce aerosols. Shedding of
  • skin cells carrying microbes. Movement resuspends settled dust microbes. Poor ventilation
  • increases airborne spread. y 5 points – (5 marks)

questions.final_answer: increases airborne spread. y 5 points

questions.question: Discuss the concept of cometabolism in pesticide degradation.
questions.solution_html:
• Cometabolism in pesticide degradation (10 marks)
  • • Definition: degradation of pesticide without being used as an energy source (2). Requires the
  • presence of another substrate (2) - Microbes produce enzymes for the primary substrate (2) -
  • These enzymes act on the pesticide (2) - Leads to partial/complete breakdown of toxic
  • compounds (1) - Important in the removal of persistent pesticides from the environment (1)
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026
questions.final_answer: compounds (1) - Important in the removal of persistent pesticides from the environment (1)
